### last time {.smaller}

*  fragmentation
   *  split IP packets into multiple pieces
   *  IPv4: done by routers unless Don't Fragment (DF) flag set
   *  usually undesirable: cost to reconstruct; 
*  flooding idea
   *  every router shares with neighbors; repeat
*  spanning tree protocol
   *  choose specific spanning tree by ordering tree roots, links
   *  each node chooses correct uplink, shares with neighbors
   *  use neighbor's uplink option if earlier in ordering
